      "fix": {
        "old": "\\id_{K^{\\sheafk +1}i}",
        "new": "\\id_{K^{\\sheafk +1_i}}"

      "note": "The i is a subscript of 1 inside the exponent of K, not a separate factor outside that exponent."

      "scan": "\\sigma^{\\underline{k}}=(-1)^{k+1}\\id_{F(K^{-k-1})}",

      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\sigma^{k}=(-1)^{k+1}\\id_{F(K^{-k-1})}",
      "note": "The print mistakenly uses the underlined multi-index notation: here k is an ordinary integer degree. The TeX records the printed reading and corrects it through sisi."
